data.one_liner: Mobile sensing framework for collecting sensor and device data via configurable probes.
data.what_it_does: A software framework for collecting sensor and device data from phones and wearables using probes, triggers, and tasks. It handles scheduling, local SQLite storage, and background sampling across multiple platforms.
use_when: You need to build a digital phenotyping or mHealth app requiring continuous background sensor data collection.
You want to collect step counts, ambient light, screen events, and battery status locally or via a study protocol.
avoid_when: You only need a simple, single sensor check without a full protocol-driven management framework.
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Cross-platform support for iOS and Android.
Extensible architecture supporting custom triggers, probes, and data endpoints.
Built-in local SQLite storage and background task handling.
weaknesses: Requires careful platform-specific configuration for background execution and notifications.
Complex setup for custom study protocols and multi-device coordination.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring flutter_local_notifications for Android/iOS and flutter_background for Android along with appropriate permissions in AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist.
